items.summary: Add a Profile tab to the bottom navigation bar (alongside Home, Upload, Shorts, Subscriptions) that navigates to the authenticated user's own profile page.

Create a dedicated User Profile page that displays the authenticated user's profile information (display name, channel name, principal ID) and channel statistics (total videos uploaded, total views, total likes received), along with a grid of the user's uploaded videos and photos.
Add a '/profile' route to the router that renders the new User Profile page for the currently authenticated user.

Ensure video view counts increment only when an authenticated user has actively watched the video — the view count increment must be triggered after a minimum watch threshold (e.g., at least 5 seconds of playback), not on page load or when the video is merely loaded in the DOM.
